1) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker in a molar ratio of polyanion to polyalkylenimine of greater than 1:1.

2) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker selected from zirconium, aluminum, titanium, chromium, and iron compounds.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed metal compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, wherein the amount of polyanion exceeds the amount of polyalkylenimine on a molar basis.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, and wherein the polyalkylenimine has a molecular weight of less than 1500 Da.

9) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein the molar ratio of PVS to polyalkylenimine is greater than 1:1.

12) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, wherein said multivalent cation is selected from Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, and wherein the amount of PVS exceeds the amount of polyalkylenimine on a molar basis.

13) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein the polyalkylenimine has a molecular weight of less than 1500 Da.

21) (Currently amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1 wherein the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle has a molar ratio of polyanion to polyalkylenimine greater than 1:1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide.

24) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, wherein said polymer has a molecular weight greater than 10,000 Da.

26) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said fluid is brine or seawater, and wherein the polyalkylenimine has a molecular weight of less than 1500 Da.
